summary: Make the exported pair weight independent of chunk-id ordering: build_edges() keeps the grade from whichever anchor sorts first, so a mutual pair's weight can swing ~10 logits on lexical order alone — and that now decides which edges survive the cap

resolution.note: build_edges() now keeps max(grade) across both directions, tie-broken on via id. Measured: 98 pairs changed weight (all increases, max swing 5.510), row set unchanged at 44,330.
